One has
  \[
  |\pi(x) - \mathrm{Li}(x)| \leq 0.028 x (\log x)^{0.801}
    \exp(-0.1853 \log^{3/5} x / (\log \log x)^{1/5}))
  \]
  for all $x \geq 2$.
